name: Ultra 2 Smart Watch 7 Straps Edition | Bluetooth Call Fitness & Health Tracker
description:
The Ultra 2 Smart Watch (7 Straps Edition) combines style, performance, and versatility with seven interchangeable straps for every occasion. Featuring Bluetooth calling, heart rate monitoring, SpO₂, sleep tracking, and fitness tracking, it keeps you connected and motivated all day. With a sleek design and comfortable fit, it’s compatible with both Android and iOS devices.
Key Features
 7 interchangeable straps to match any style
 Bluetooth calling with app notifications
 Heart rate, SpO₂, sleep, and step tracking
 Sleek, durable design with comfort fit
 Multi-sport modes and fitness tracking
 Compatible with Android & iOS smartphones
Ingredients / Materials
Alloy body, Silicone straps, Electronic components
How to Use
 Charge the smartwatch fully before first use
 Connect via the companion app on Android or iOS
 Switch straps easily for different occasions
 Use touch controls and app settings to track health and receive notifications
Package Includes
 1 × Ultra 2 Smart Watch
 7 × Interchangeable Straps
 1 × Magnetic Charging Cable
 1 × User Manual
